subject: Short log retention options — ClarioHealth pilot
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.inference>
To: Marcus Lee <marcus.lee@clariohealth.com>
Cc: Nina Patel <nina.patel@clariohealth.com>
Date: Tue, 2 Feb 2027 15:08:00 -0800
Subject: Short log retention options — ClarioHealth pilot

Hi Marcus / Nina,

Thanks again for the call today — good to align on the pilot scope. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have a single place to iterate: 

Summary of ask
- Clario wants minimal retention for PII-containing inference payloads for the patient-facing triage flow. Primary goals are (1) remove identifiable inputs ASAP, (2) keep short operational metrics for debugging, (3) provide audit evidence for SOC2 review.

Redwood pilot proposal (three-track options)
1) ShortLog (default pilot) — KV & prompts kept for 24 hours then purged; aggregated metrics retained 90 days. No persistent request logs stored past 24h.
2) Tiered TTL — PII fields redacted at ingestion; KV cache kept 7 days; anonymized aggregate logs retained 30 days.
3) Custom retention schedule — per-environment TTLs (prod: 7d KV, staging: 1d) with opt-in persistent telemetry for ops only.

What we need from Clario to proceed
- Legal confirmation of the acceptable retention window (they mentioned "as close to zero as possible").
- Confirmation which data elements they consider PII (we can map these to Redwood redaction rules).
- SOC2 snapshot request for their compliance mapping (we’ll share Redwood evidence too).

Attachments I’m including for your review: [attachment: DPA_draft_v2.docx], [attachment: SOC2_snapshot_Redwood-2026.pdf]

Next steps (proposed)
- Marcus/Nina: confirm preferred option (ShortLog or Tiered TTL) by Fri 02/05.
- If Tiered or Custom: we’ll draft a narrow DPA addendum and send to your legal for redlines.
- Internal: loop in Lauren (security) and Priya (solutions) to prepare technical runbook for the pilot.

Thanks — happy to hop on 15m call if that helps.

Best,
Rishi
Sr. Account Exec, Redwood Inference
Direct: (415) 555-0182

--
Redwood Inference

From: Marcus Lee <marcus.lee@clariohealth.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.inference>
Cc: Nina Patel <nina.patel@clariohealth.com>, ClarioHealth Legal <legal@clariohealth.com>
Date: Wed, 3 Feb 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Short log retention options — ClarioHealth pilot

Rishi — thanks for the summary. Quick clarifications from our side: 

1) We are pushing for effectively zero retention for any PII (PHI) in prod. If the ShortLog option can guarantee automatic deletion within 24 hours and show proof of deletion, that's reasonable for the initial pilot. For anything beyond 24h we will need explicit justification.
2) Audit evidence: our Security & Risk team will want a SOC2 excerpt showing log retention controls and deletion verification procedures.
3) We need a formal DPA addendum before any pilot runs in our prod-like environment.

Nina and I discussed: happy to run ShortLog for a 30-day pilot if Redwood provides: 
- A DPA addendum with explicit TTL language and deletion confirmation steps.
- A short tech runbook showing how deleted KV data is irrecoverable (i.e. beyond simple flags).
- A sample report from Redwood proving periodic purge operations (even a CSV showing timestamps).

Cc’ing Legal so they can propose preferred contract language and timeline.

— Marcus
Head of Platform, ClarioHealth

On Wed, Feb 3, 2027 at 09:12 AM ClarioHealth Legal <legal@clariohealth.com> wrote:
> Marcus — please add a point about encryption-at-rest key custody and whether Redwood can restrict key material to a dedicated HSM for Clario.
>
> - CL Legal

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.inference>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.inference>, Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.inference>
Cc: Marcus Lee <marcus.lee@clariohealth.com>, Nina Patel <nina.patel@clariohealth.com>
Date: Wed, 3 Feb 2027 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Short log retention options — ClarioHealth pilot

Folks — forwarding Clario’s ask. TL;DR they want: 
- ShortLog pilot (24h deletion guarantee) in a prod-like environment
- DPA addendum with explicit TTL/deletion verification language
- Tech runbook showing irrecoverable deletion for KV and request logs
- Optional HSM key custody requirement from legal

Can you advise: 
- Lauren: what evidence (SOC2 excerpts / deletion logs) can we package quickly? I attached the SOC2 snapshot we have.
- Priya: can the runbook include a small PoC using our purge API + checksum proof? How much ops time to stand up the pilot?

I’m proposing we send an interim DPA addendum with 24h TTL language and a 30-day pilot clause, and also offer a follow-up plan for HSM key custody options (we can escalate to Dedicated/Private if needed).

Attachments forwarded: [attachment: DPA_draft_v2.docx], [attachment: SOC2_snapshot_Redwood-2026.pdf]

If we can turn around the DPA in 48-72 hours and produce a simple purge-report example, Clario has agreed in principle to start the pilot.

Thanks — r

--
Rishi Malhotra
Sr. Account Exec, Redwood Inference

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.inference>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.inference>, Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.inference>
Cc: Marcus Lee <marcus.lee@clariohealth.com>, Nina Patel <nina.patel@clariohealth.com>, ClarioHealth Legal <legal@clariohealth.com>
Date: Thu, 4 Feb 2027 10:32:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: Short log retention options — ClarioHealth pilot

Rishi / Priya — quick update from Security: 

- We can produce a SOC2 excerpt focused on data disposal controls (will redact non-relevant sections). I attached a 1-page pull highlighting the relevant control objectives.
- Deletion verification: our purge pipeline has an immutable audit trail (WORM) entry per purge job. We can produce a sample purge report (CSV with object id + deletion timestamp) as proof for the pilot.
- HSM custody: we support customer-managed keys via KMS integrations; for an irrevocable HSM-only model we’ll need a short DRA (risk acceptance) and an uplift to our Dedicated/Private offering — we should flag cost/SLA tradeoffs to the customer.

Priya — if you can draft a concise runbook that: (a) calls the purge API, (b) captures the purge job id, (c) exports a sample audit CSV, and (d) shows a checksum-based irrecoverability test — we can include that with the interim DPA. Assume 1 engineer day to assemble + 0.5d ops to run sample.

Marcus — we’ll prepare the DPA addendum language with 24h TTL and a 30-day pilot clause for signature. Would you prefer DocuSign or a redline in Word first?

Best,
Lauren
Director, Security Assurance — Redwood Inference
